data.title: It's advantage Thailand in Asean semi
data.description: <p>Thailand took a decisive step towards the Asean Hyundai Cup final as striker Teerasak Poeiphimai struck twice in the opening half to secure a 3-1 away win over Singapore on Saturday night.</p>

data.title: Kunlavut begins bid to reclaim world title
data.description: <p>Former champion Kunlavut Vitidsarn will face Viren Nettasinghe of Sri Lanka in the first round of the BWF World Championships as 18 Thai players will compete in all five categories of the 2026 tournament, beginning today in New Delhi.</p>

data.title: BJT demands proof of poll fraud claims
data.description: <p>The Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) is unfazed by the opposition's planned no-confidence debate, saying allegations of fraud in the Senate election must be backed by evidence.</p>

data.title: New school design  'can limit casualties'
data.description: <p>A Thammasat University study has proposed changes to school buildings and grounds that it says could help reduce casualties in mass shootings by slowing attackers and giving students and staff more time to escape or take shelter.</p>

data.title: Thailand eyes Dawei port role
data.description: <p>Thailand is positioning itself as a key player in the proposed Dawei deep-sea port project in Myanmar, as Russia expresses interest in investing in major infrastructure projects in the region, including the long-delayed port.</p>

data.title: Hopes pinned on Si Sa Ket wat
data.description: <p>Si Sa Ket, a relatively low-profile tourist destination, is being positioned for greater attention through a tourism push centred on cultural, spiritual and natural attractions.</p>

data.title: Gun control calls fall short
data.description: <p>The Nonthaburi school shooting and the killing of Nonthaburi provincial administrative organisation chief have put gun control back in spotlight, renewing calls for tighter controls on firearm ownership and carrying.</p>

data.title: Barcelona reach deal with Man City to sign Rodri
data.description: BARCELONA - Barcelona have reached a deal with Manchester City to sign Spanish World Cup winner Rodri, a source from the Catalan club told AFP Sunday.

data.title: Records for Asher-Smith, Hunt as Britain win 4x100m mixed relay
data.description: BIRMINGHAM (UNITED KINGDOM) - Amy Hunt bagged a record fourth gold at the European championships on Sunday as part of the winning British quartet in the 4x100m mixed relay.

data.title: Hamas expects meeting with Kushner as US pushes Gaza plan
data.description: CAIRO - Hamas sources said on Sunday that they expected to meet in Egypt with US envoy Jared Kushner, as President Donald Trump's administration seeks to push forward a Gaza peace plan rejected by Israel.

data.title: Europe wildfires: latest developments
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Two people died when fires broke out on a Greek island, and Belgium was tackling a record blaze in its east Sunday, as Europe faced wildfires spurred by high temperatures and tinder-dry conditions.

data.title: Students take home 4 medals
data.description: Thai students have won four medals at International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) 2026 in Uzbekistan, the Promotion of Teaching Science and Technology (IPST) says.

data.title: Cabinet nod gets Hat Yai monorail on track
data.description: The Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) is set to advance Songkhla province’s Hat Yai monorail project after the cabinet approved its authority to operate rail services in the province.

data.title: Air support kicks in as record Belgian wildfire jumps in size
data.description: BAELEN (BELGIUM) - Crucial air support swung into action Sunday to help firefighters tame Belgium's largest modern-day wildfire, which has mushroomed in size since breaking out two days ago in a hard-to-access nature reserve.

data.title: Falling tree injures 4 Spaniards at Ayutthaya historical park
data.description: PHRA NAKHON SI AYUTTHAYA - A large flame tree collapsed in the grounds of historical Wat Phra Si Sanphet temple on Sunday, injuring four Spanish tourists - one seriously.

data.title: 'Wanted' Chinese fraudster arrested in Pattaya
data.description: PATTAYA - Police have arrested a 30-year-old Chinese man wanted by authorities in China for alleged fraud and money laundering, and he will be extradited to his homeland.

data.title: Police stakeout illegal racers with a roadside BBQ
data.description: SAMUT PRAKAN - Undercover police work often involves disguises, surveillance and patience. In Bang Phli on Saturday night, it also involved a <i>moo krata</i> grill.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nico Carrillo rules out more kickboxing ‘side fights’ unless title is at stake
data.description: Nico Carrillo has ruled out taking any more kickboxing “side fights” in ONE Championship unless a world title is at stake, with the Scot now focused on securing his first defence of the featherweight Muay Thai belt.

data.title: Mass drone attack on Moscow as Russian strikes kill three in Ukraine
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Hundreds of drones targeted Moscow on Sunday as Russia launched missile strikes that killed three people and wounded more than a dozen in Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, officials on the two sides said.

data.title: Vast peat fire burning in major swamp forest
data.description: NAKHON SI THAMMARAT - A vast fire is still burning in the Phru Khuan Khreng peat swamp forest in this southern province, defying firefighters' efforts three days after it erupted.

data.title: Ministry acts to end dispute between Israelis and Samui zoo owner
data.description: The Interior Ministry will take action to end the dispute between the owner of an exotic animal zoo on Koh Samui and an Israeli family who were refused entry, Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee said on Sunday.

data.title: Thousands await aid after deadly Indonesian quake
data.description: RUTENG, Indonesia - Help started arriving Sunday for thousands of evacuees on Indonesia's Flores island after a powerful earthquake killed 48 people, injured dozens and damaged hundreds of houses and buildings.

data.title: Ukrainian social media channels track incoming Russian missiles
data.description: KYIV - The chances of a missile attack on Kyiv that night were around 50 percent, according to the administrator of a social media channel monitoring Russian air raids.

data.title: UK's media-savvy PM Burnham shifts messaging to TikTok, podcasts
data.description: LONDON - Whether he is pulling a pint, tossing a builder's helmet in the air or running with Olympic medallist Mo Farah, the UK's new prime minister Andy Burnham has embraced social media with a deft touch.

data.title: North, Northeast forecast is for heavy rain, flood risk
data.description: Heavy to very heavy rain is expected across parts of northern and northeastern Thailand rom Tuesday into Friday, raising the risk of flash floods and forest runoff in vulnerable areas.

data.title: Hope fades for finding survivors of Colombia quake as rescued woman dies
data.description: PEREIRA (COLOMBIA) - A Colombian woman who was rescued after being trapped for nearly 37 hours under the rubble in the wake of a strong earthquake has died of her injuries, her family told AFP on Saturday.
